title: Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Development
description:
Job Summary Litmos is looking for a Mobile Developer to help evolve our iOS and Android applications. You will work across our existing native apps (Swift and Kotlin), build new features in React Native, and own the WebView experience that brings Litmos learning content into the mobile apps. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable moving between native code, React Native, and web content, and who cares about a smooth learner experience on mobile. Responsibilities Build and maintain mobile features in React Native for iOS and Android. Extend and support our existing native iPhone (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps, including hosting React Native screens within them. Own WebView-based experiences such as embedded LMS and course content: authentication and session handling, native-to-web communication (JavaScript bridges), deep links, file handling, and performance. Contribute to the plan for consolidating native and cross-platform code, helping decide what moves to React Native and what stays native. Implement new mobile capabilities such as push notifications, offline support, biometric login, and device permissions. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and manage App Store and Google Play releases, including versioning, signing, and phased rollouts. Write unit and integration tests, review code, debug production issues, and monitor app stability and crash reports. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and backend teams in an Agile environment. Required Qualifications 3-5 years of professional mobile development experience. Solid hands-on experience with React Native and TypeScript/JavaScript in shipped production apps. Strong understanding of WebViews on iOS and Android: loading and securing web content, cookies and sessions, JS bridges, navigation, and debugging web content inside apps. Experience publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. Familiarity with mobile CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, or similar) and release management. Experience consuming REST APIs and handling authentication (OAuth/SSO, token management). Good communication skills and the ability to work in a distributed team. Preferred Qualifications Working knowledge of Swift (UIKit/SwiftUI, WKWebView) and Kotlin (Android SDK, Android WebView). Experience with native modules / bridging native code to React Native. Experience integrating React Native into existing native apps (brownfield). Experience with e-learning content (SCORM, xAPI) or LMS platforms. Mobile accessibility and performance optimization experience. Experience with mobile security practices and app analytics/crash tools. Success in the First Year Independently delivering React Native features and WebView improvements to production. Reduced WebView-related defects and improved learner experience on mobile. Reliable, repeatable release process for both iOS and Android. Meaningful contribution to the native vs. React Native roadmap.

title: Principal Technical Consultant, ServiceNow
description:
We are seeking an expert-level ServiceNow Principal Technical Consultant to join our organization. In this role, you will be the principal technical owner for our most complex ServiceNow programs. You will lead the architecture, design, and deployment of innovative solutions, leveraging deep expertise across the ServiceNow platform. This role requires a blend of elite technical skills, strong leadership, and the ability to act as a thought leader and trusted advisor to our senior management and key customers. 

 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Lead project teams and mentor developers to design, architect, and deploy complex, scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. Own the solution architecture for complex, multi-module programs, coordinating resources across technical teams and organizational practices. Lead the architecture and design of end-to-end solutions, including custom applications, highly scalable Service Portal frameworks, and complex orchestration flows. Lead integration design sessions, defining a robust strategy for connecting ServiceNow with third-party tools using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and MID Servers. Lead client workshops and requirements-gathering sessions as the primary technical and process expert, translating business needs into detailed technical specifications and design documents. Lead the creation of critical written deliverables (architecture diagrams, solution design documents, best-practice guides) and present compelling client demos and working sessions. Serve as the primary technical escalation point for the project team, troubleshooting and resolving the most complex platform issues. Participate actively in the pre-sales cycle as a subject matter expert, assisting with solutioning, estimation, and strategic roadmap planning. Provide concrete thought leadership to internal teams and our customers on platform best practices, governance, and emerging capabilities. Craft innovative and high-impact solutions for complex client challenges, relying on large teams to implement. Drive consensus with senior customer stakeholders in solving complex solution challenges. 

 
 10+ years of ServiceNow experience, with at least 3 years as a subject matter expert in ServiceNow architecture and development. Expert knowledge and proven implementation experience in multiple ServiceNow modules, with mandatory expertise inat least two ServiceNowProducts(ITOM/ITAM/CSM/SecOps/IRM/HRSD). Deep experience within the process areas of the ServiceNow Products. Expert-level development skills on platform features, including but not limited to advanced scripting (JavaScript, Glide API, Script Includes), Flow Designer, Service Portal, and custom application development. Strong, hands-on skills integrating ServiceNow with third-party tools, with deep expertise in IntegrationHub , REST/SOAP APIs, and data governance best practices. Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs to senior management and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to design highly scalable solutions and articulate trade-offs between different architectural approaches. Strong project and situational awareness with a self-starter mentality and meticulous attention to detail. 

 Required Certifications 
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), any Product line 

 Preferred Certifications 
 ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) is a significant bonus. 

 Expectations 
 Act as a lead contributor and thought leader, defining and enforcing platform-wide best practices, governance frameworks, and reusable assets. Be an early adopter of new ServiceNow platform features and certifications, actively mentoring junior team members on new capabilities. Serve as a key resource for the presales team, helping to identify, scope, and position complex, cross-practice solutions for new and existing clients. Lead and mentor development teams, performing code audits and solution quality checks to ensure high-impact, high-quality deliverables. Drive consensus with senior client stakeholders, and lead the scoping, planning, and methodology for critical projects, including platform upgrades and performance tuning. Work on the organization's most impactful and unique technical challenges, contributing to projects that address future concepts, products, and technologies. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)

 Experience: 4+ years of relevant Power Platform experience About Gigmos Gigmos is a global technical support and managed services company built on a dual workforce model - a core team of permanent employees supported by a distributed pool of experienced technical professionals. Our workforce operates across 9+ countries , supporting clients in 6+ global languages . Gigmos has been a delivery partner to Microsoft for over six years . We support enterprise customers by providing technical expertise across Microsoft technologies and other business-critical platforms. Why This Role Exists We are looking for an experienced Power Apps Power Automate Support Engineer with 4+ years of hands-on experience to provide technical support for Microsoft Power Platform solutions used by enterprise customers. The role involves investigating complex customer-reported issues, reproducing problems, identifying root causes, providing appropriate resolutions, and documenting cases accurately. This is a hands-on technical support role requiring strong practical experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, connectors, integrations, and Power Platform environments. Key Responsibilities Power Apps Support Troubleshoot Canvas and Model-Driven Apps , including formula/expression errors, delegation warnings, control behaviour, performance, and load-time issues. Resolve data source and connector issues such as authentication, refresh failures, connector limitations, and throttling. Troubleshoot Dataverse , including tables, columns, relationships, security roles, permissions, and business rules. Support environment and ALM issues, including solution imports, managed/unmanaged solutions, environment variables, and deployment failures. Handle licensing and entitlement-related queries, including premium connector requirements. Investigate complex application performance and functionality issues and identify appropriate root-cause resolutions. Power Automate Support Troubleshoot Cloud Flow failures, trigger conditions, run-history errors, expressions, dynamic content, loops, and concurrency. Support Power Automate Desktop/RPA issues, including machine registration, unattended runs, credentials, and gateway problems. Troubleshoot Approvals, scheduled flows, and integrations with Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Dataverse. Handle throttling, API limits, retry policies, and performance issues. Troubleshoot DLP policy blocks and governance-related failures . Analyze complex workflow failures and provide sustainable resolutions rather than temporary fixes. description:
Role Summary 
 We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support for Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and robotic automation systems at customer sites. The engineer will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex issues spanning software, embedded systems, networking, controls, electrical systems, and mechanical integration. The role requires strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and the ability to work across multiple engineering disciplines. Key Responsibilities 
 Commission and validate robotic systems at customer sites. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, electrical, and networking issues. Perform root cause analysis for field failures and recommend corrective actions. Support installation, configuration, calibration, and acceptance testing of robotic systems. Debug ROS-based software stacks and system-level integrations. Analyze system logs, diagnostics, and performance data to identify failures. Work closely with Product Engineering, Controls, Mechanical, Electronics, and Software teams to resolve complex technical issues. Document field observations, investigation reports, and corrective actions. Develop and execute validation procedures for new features and fixes. Support customers remotely and onsite during commissioning and production operations. Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to product development teams to improve product reliability.  Core Competencies 
 Strong analytical and logical reasoning Systems thinking Structured problem-solving Hypothesis-driven debugging Root cause analysis Attention to detail Ability to work under time-critical situations Cross-functional collaboration Technical documentation and reporting Customer-facing communication 
 Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AMRs, AGVs, autonomous systems, or industrial automation products is preferred. 
 What Success Looks Like

Work effectively across software, hardware, controls, and mechanical domains. Communicate technical findings clearly to both customers and internal engineering teams.
